title_en: Supreme People's Court's Second Five-Year Reform Outline for the People's Courts (2004-2008)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Second Five-Year Reform Outline of the People's Courts (2004-2008)

Fa Fa [2005] No. 18

In 1999, in accordance with the requirements of the Fifteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China to promote judicial reform, the Supreme People's Court formulated and issued the "Five-Year Reform Outline of the People's Courts," making unified arrangements for judicial reform across courts nationwide from 1999 to 2003. Over the past five years and more, people's courts at all levels throughout the country, taking fairness and efficiency as the theme and reform as the driving force, have earnestly implemented the "Five-Year Reform Outline of the People's Courts," basically completed all reform tasks, initially established a trial mode suited to China's national conditions, and provided a certain institutional guarantee for judicial fairness; basically straightened out the trial institutions of our country, improved the three major trial systems of criminal, civil, and administrative trials, making the court organization system more rational; expanded the trial authority of collegiate panels and sole judges, laying the foundation for achieving organic unity of trial and judgment; implemented a new mechanism for court enforcement work, alleviating the difficulty of enforcement to a certain extent, and conducted useful explorations for deepening institutional reform; established the goal of professionalization of judges, rationally allocated judicial human resources, and significantly improved the overall judicial capacity of the people's courts; accelerated the modernization of judicial equipment, and the basic construction and material support of most courts nationwide have been greatly improved.

In 2002, the Sixteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China put forward the requirement to actively and steadily promote the reform of the judicial system. In particular, at the end of 2004, the Party Central Committee made comprehensive arrangements for the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms for a period of time to come. At present, the relatively lagging judicial system and working mechanisms can no longer meet the growing demands of the people for judicial fairness and justice. The judicial reform of the people's courts faces both rare historical opportunities and severe challenges from multiple aspects, and these challenges raise higher requirements for judicial system reform. In order to implement the tasks of reforming the judicial system and working mechanisms deployed by the Party Central Committee, further deepen various reforms of the people's courts, improve the organizational system and operating mechanisms of the people's courts, enhance judicial capacity, raise the level of justice, and ensure the realization of fairness and justice throughout society, the "Second Five-Year Reform Outline of the People's Courts (2004-2008)" is hereby formulated.

The basic tasks and objectives of the judicial reform of the people's courts from 2004 to 2008 are: to reform and improve litigation procedure systems, achieve judicial fairness, improve judicial efficiency, and maintain judicial authority; to reform and improve enforcement systems and working mechanisms, improve enforcement institutions, perfect enforcement procedures, optimize the enforcement environment, and further resolve the "difficulty in enforcement"; to reform and improve trial organizations and trial institutions, achieving organic unity of trial and judgment; to reform and improve judicial trial management and judicial administrative management systems, providing full support and services for the people's courts to perform their trial functions; to reform and improve judicial personnel management systems, strengthen the protection of judges' profession, and advance the process of professionalization of judges; to reform and strengthen internal supervision of the people's courts and the systems for accepting external supervision, improve the supervision mechanism over the operation of trial power, enforcement power, and management power, and maintain judicial integrity; to continuously promote the reform of the systems and working mechanisms of the people's courts, and establish a modern judicial system that meets the requirements of a socialist country ruled by law.

In promoting the judicial reform of the people's courts, the following basic principles must be adhered to: adhere to the leadership of the Party, fully implement the Party's line, principles, and policies, and grasp the political direction of court judicial reform from the perspective of consolidating the Party's ruling status and improving the Party's governing capacity; adhere to the system of people's congresses, consciously accept the supervision of the people's congresses and their standing committees, and maintain the socialist democratic characteristics of our country's judicial system; adhere to the Constitution and laws as the basis, maintain the unity of the legal system, ensure that the people's courts independently exercise judicial power according to law, and maintain judicial authority; adhere to the guiding principle of fair justice and wholehearted service to the people, achieve judicial fairness, facilitate litigation by the masses, and respect and protect human rights; adhere to the scientific concept of development, follow the objective laws of justice, and reflect the essential characteristics of openness, independence, neutrality, procedural regularity, and finality of trial work; adhere to proceeding from China's national conditions and draw on beneficial achievements of foreign judicial reform.

The main content of the judicial reform of the people's courts from 2004 to 2008 is:

I. Reform and Improve Litigation Procedure Systems

1. Reform and improve the trial procedures for death penalty cases. When the people's court tries a case that may result in the death penalty in accordance with the first instance procedure, witnesses and expert witnesses shall appear in court, except where the defendant pleads guilty or there is no dispute over evidence between the prosecution and the defense. After 2006, death penalty cases tried by the people's court in accordance with the second instance procedure shall all be tried in open court, and relevant witnesses and expert witnesses shall appear in court.

2. Reform and improve the death penalty review procedure. Implement the relevant legal provisions and the central government's deployment on judicial system reform, have the Supreme People's Court uniformly exercise the power of approval of death sentences, and formulate judicial interpretations on the death penalty review procedure.

3. Reform the criminal evidence system, formulate rules of criminal evidence, lawfully exclude verbal evidence obtained through illegal means such as extortion of confessions by torture, strengthen the appearance of witnesses and expert witnesses in court, further implement the principles of human rights protection and presumption of innocence, and timely put forward legislative suggestions on criminal evidence.

4. Reform the jurisdiction system for civil cases. Change the standard for determining jurisdiction by level based solely on the amount in controversy, reform the method of jurisdiction for inter-regional civil cases, establish a jurisdiction system for first instance cases that combines the amount in controversy with the region to which the parties belong, and strengthen the application of provisions on elevating jurisdiction and designated jurisdiction. Gradually achieve that higher people's courts do not hear first instance cases that do not have general legal application significance.

5. Reform and improve the jurisdiction system for administrative cases, eliminating various factors that interfere with administrative trials from the system. Reform and improve administrative litigation procedures to accumulate experience for the amendment of the Administrative Procedure Law, and timely put forward legislative suggestions.

6. Continue to explore simplified forms of civil litigation procedures, establish a fast-track adjudication procedure system on the basis of simplified civil procedures, and standardize the organizational structure, operating procedures, trial methods, judgment document formats, etc., for hearing small-sum debt cases.

7. Strengthen and improve the litigation mediation system, attach importance to guiding people's mediation work, and support and supervise arbitration activities in accordance with the law. Explore new dispute resolution methods together with other departments and organizations to promote the establishment and improvement of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism.

8. Reform and improve pre-trial procedures. Clarify the different functions of pre-trial procedures and trial procedures, standardize activities such as rulings on procedural matters, pre-trial mediation, pretrial conferences, exchange of evidence, and technical review of evidence, and clarify the functional organs and personnel division for handling pre-trial procedural matters.

9. Reform the trial supervision system for civil and administrative cases, protect the lawful rights of the parties, and maintain the res judicata of judgments. Explore the establishment of a system of retrial claims, clarify the conditions and time limits for applying for retrial, case jurisdiction, retrial procedures, etc., and ensure from the system that parties can equally exercise their litigation rights.

10. Further implement the principle of open trial in accordance with the law, adopt new measures for judicial openness, determine the scope and methods of openness for relevant links in the case processing chain, provide various channels for the public to fully understand the functions and activities of the court, and enhance the transparency of the people's courts' trial work, enforcement work, and other work.

II. Reform and Improve Systems for Trial Guidance and Uniform Application of Law

11. Implement the principle of proportionality between crime and punishment, formulate guiding opinions on the application of the death penalty for crimes such as intentional homicide, robbery, intentional injury, and drug offenses, to ensure the correct application of the death penalty. Study and formulate sentencing guidelines for other crimes, and improve and establish relatively independent sentencing procedures.

12. Reform the practice whereby lower people's courts seek instructions from higher people's courts on difficult issues of legal application. For cases with general legal application significance, lower people's courts may, upon the application of a party or ex officio, refer the case to a higher people's court for trial. The higher people's court may directly try the case if it finds upon review that the conditions are met.

13. Establish and improve the case guidance system, attach importance to the role of guiding cases in unifying standards of legal application, guiding the trial work of lower courts, and enriching and developing legal theory. The Supreme People's Court formulates normative documents on the case guidance system, stipulating the criteria, procedures, release methods, and guiding rules for the compilation and selection of guiding cases.

14. Reform and improve the procedures of the Supreme People's Court for formulating judicial interpretations, further improve the quality of judicial interpretations. The Supreme People's Court exercises unified organization and coordination over the initiation, drafting, review, coordination, publication, and filing of judicial interpretations, and periodically reviews, amends, abrogates, and compiles judicial interpretations. Standardize the system for the Supreme People's Court to submit judicial interpretations to the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress for record.

15. Establish a coordination mechanism for legal views and understandings between courts, between trial institutions within a court, and between trial organizations, to unify judicial standards. Further establish and improve other effective methods to ensure the uniform, equal, and fair application of law by the people's courts.

III. Reform and Improve Enforcement Systems and Working Mechanisms

16. Further reform and improve the enforcement system of the people's courts. The enforcement organ of the Supreme People's Court supervises and guides the enforcement work of courts nationwide. The enforcement organs of higher people's courts in provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government uniformly manage and coordinate enforcement work within their respective regions.

17. Deepen the reform of the enforcement power operation mechanism. The enforcement organs of people's courts at all levels are responsible for the enforcement of judgments and rulings in civil and administrative cases and other statutory enforcement instruments, as well as the enforcement of property-related parts in criminal judgments and rulings (including property-related punishments). For substantive disputes that need to be resolved through trial procedures during enforcement, they shall be tried by a trial organization other than the enforcement organ, and a specialized trial institution may be established if necessary. Establish remedies such as the right of parties and third persons to apply for reconsideration of decisions made by the enforcement organ on important procedural matters.

18. Reform and improve enforcement procedures, strengthen judicial interpretation work on enforcement, actively promote the legislative process for enforcement, and standardize the conduct of various enforcement entities.

19. Establish a nationwide court enforcement case information management system, participate in the construction of the social credit system, establish an enforcement supervision mechanism, and urge the person subject to enforcement to voluntarily perform obligations. By disclosing enforcement information, strengthen the management and supervision of enforcement work to ensure enforcement fairness.

20. Reform and improve the jurisdiction system for enforcement cases, to improve enforcement efficiency, save enforcement costs, eliminate various interferences, and ensure that the legitimate rights and interests of the winning party are realized in a timely manner.

21. Explore new methods for enforcement work. In coordination with relevant departments, implement measures such as property declaration, compulsory audit, restriction of exit, and publication of the list of persons subject to enforcement who fail to perform obligations determined by the enforcement instrument.

22. Reform and improve the procedural system for hearing criminal cases of refusal to comply with judgments and rulings of the people's courts, and increase the intensity of judicial sanctions against non-compliance with effective judgments and acts that hinder enforcement.

IV. Reform and Improve Trial Organizations and Trial Institutions

23. Reform the system of the adjudication committee of the people's courts. The Supreme People's Court's Adjudication Committee shall establish a Criminal Specialized Committee and a Civil and Administrative Specialized Committee; Higher People's Courts and Intermediate People's Courts may, as needed, establish Criminal Specialized Committees and Civil and Administrative Specialized Committees within the Adjudication Committee. Reform the membership structure of the Adjudication Committee to ensure that high-level senior judges can enter the Adjudication Committee. Reform the procedures and methods for the Adjudication Committee to hear cases, changing the activities of the Adjudication Committee from a conference system to a trial system; reform the voting mechanism of the Adjudication Committee; improve the working organs of the Adjudication Committee.

24. Members of the Adjudication Committee may form a collegiate panel by themselves or together with other judges to hear major, difficult, complex cases or cases with general legal application significance.

25. Further strengthen the trial responsibilities of presidents, vice-presidents, division chiefs, and deputy division chiefs, clarify their trial management responsibilities and administrative management responsibilities, explore the establishment of new management models, and achieve centralization and specialization of judicial administrative management.

26. Establish a responsibility system for judges to independently adjudicate cases according to law, strengthen the trial responsibilities of collegiate panels and sole judges. Presidents, vice-presidents, division chiefs, and deputy division chiefs shall participate in collegiate panels to hear cases. Gradually realize a collegiate panel and sole judge responsibility system.

27. Fully implement the "Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Improving the People's Juror System," improve the management system for people's jurors, formulate judicial interpretations on ensuring that people's jurors exercise their judicial power fairly, and give full play to the function of the people's juror system.

28. Reform and improve the working mechanism of people's tribunals, implement systems for people's tribunals to directly accept cases, conduct judicial mediation, apply simplified procedures, enforce simple cases, etc., strengthen the connection between people's tribunals and society, enhance the management and material support of people's tribunals, and raise the judicial level of people's tribunals.

50. Improve the organizational structure for hearing criminal cases involving minors and civil and administrative cases concerning the protection of the rights and interests of minors, and conduct pilot projects for establishing juvenile courts in large cities where conditions permit, in order to meet the special needs of juvenile justice work and promote the establishment and improvement of a juvenile justice system with Chinese characteristics.

The judicial reform of the people's courts is a process of continuously emancipating the mind, updating concepts, and promoting theoretical and institutional innovation. To this end, people's courts at all levels shall, in accordance with the requirements of this Outline, deeply study and grasp the objective laws of judicature, deeply understand and firmly establish modern judicial concepts, and promote judicial reform with a reform-oriented mindset; further strengthen organizational leadership, improve coordination mechanisms, perfect relevant systems, make careful arrangements, properly organize, and implement earnestly; promptly summarize experience, strengthen theoretical guidance, and enhance the demonstration of specific reform plans, taking the realization of the theme of "justice and efficiency" as the basic standard for testing reform results to ensure the smooth and healthy development of reform; adhere to law-based reform, promote the continuous development and improvement of China's legal system through reform, and effectively prevent spontaneous reform and illegal reform. To ensure the correct, unified, and orderly implementation of this Outline, the Supreme People's Court will formulate specific implementation plans for various reform measures, implementing them uniformly from top to bottom. People's courts at all levels shall adhere to the guidance of Deng Xiaoping Theory and the Important Thought of "Three Represents," establish and implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, earnestly implement the spirit of the Central Committee's reform of the judicial system, correctly understand the reform guiding ideology, basic principles, basic objectives, main tasks, and basic requirements established in this Outline, pay close attention to implementation, strive for practical results, and steadily push forward the judicial reform work and other tasks of the people's courts, striving to build a modern socialist judicial system of our country and a socialist harmonious society.

October 26, 2005
